name: RELX PLC
price_source: REL.L = 2,359 GBX (£23.59) close 22-Jun-2026, cross-checked StockAnalysis.com (intraday 2,328p, -1.3%), RELX IR LSE quote page, and share-price WebSearch. Consistent with JSON verified price.
owner_fcf_base: Owner FCF FY2025 = £2,250m = reported FCF £2,313m (before dividends, cash conversion 99%) minus 100% SBC £63m. SBC is exceptionally low (0.66% of revenue; net dilution minimal as RELX buys shares via EBT £76m). Owner FCF per share ≈ £1.257.

conservador.note: Phase-1 CAGR 4% (AI fear partially materializes: slower legal/scientific info growth, some volume pressure, but no collapse), Phase-2 declining to terminal g=3.0%, WACC 8.5%. Reasonable-pessimistic, not apocalyptic.

base.note: Phase-1 CAGR 7% (in line with FY2025 organic +7% and long track record), Phase-2 declining to g=3.0%. AI net-neutral-to-positive; continued modest margin expansion.

optimista.note: Phase-1 CAGR 9% (AI as monetizable tailwind across LexisNexis/Risk/STM, pricing power and embedded analytics), terminal g=3.5%. Multiple re-rates as fears fade.

multiple_rationale: Anchored to 5y forward P/E avg of ~24.5x with an explicit ~3.5x haircut to 21x. The haircut reflects a genuine regime change in how the market prices premium information franchises under generative-AI disruption risk (de-rating from ~24-25x to ~16-17x), which is unlikely to fully reverse to prior peak multiples even if fundamentals hold. The haircut is NOT larger because the AI threat is so far a sentiment/rotation story, not operational deterioration: FY2025 delivered +7% organic growth, adjusted margin expansion to 34.8%, ROIC up to 15.4%, and positive FY2026 guidance. fwd_multiple_now 16.7x derived from price £23.59 / FY2026 adj EPS ~141p.
structural_change: No confirmed operational/structural deterioration as of FY2025: organic growth +7%, margin expansion, ROIC up, minimal SBC, net debt/EBITDA 2.0x. The "structural change" is in MARKET PERCEPTION — fear that generative AI / legal-research automation erodes the moat of premium information & analytics providers — driving a multiple de-rating (~-33% vs 5y forward avg, ~-43% off 52w high). This is a fear_rotation, not a fundamentals break. Fair multiple haircut (24.5x→21x) prices in a permanently somewhat-lower multiple regime; DCF conservador scenario stress-tests the case where AI fears partially materialize into slower growth.
sanity_notes: Magnitude checks all pass. implied_mcap = £23.59 × 1.79B = £42.2B = ~$55.7B USD (GBP/USD ~1.32), matching StockAnalysis ($54.8B) and known ~$55B scale — mcap_sanity_ok=true. Share count: 1,804,427,533 in issue ex-treasury (26-Feb-2026); using 1.79B diluted to reflect ongoing 2026 buybacks (£2,250m planned). IV/price ratios all within sane band: DCF weighted 1.05x, multiple 1.26x, reconciled 1.17x — none outside 30-300% rule, so no units/FX/shares error. fwd P/E now 16.7x cross-checks JSON 16.5 and StockAnalysis 16.3-16.8. All IVs and price in GBP (£). Reconciled IV £27.71 implies ~17.5% upside vs £23.59. Weighting tilts to multiple (0.40/0.60) as RELX is a stable, proven, low-capex compounder where pure DCF under-credits decades of high-ROIC reinvestment; the conservador DCF (0.38 prob) keeps the estimate disciplined against the AI tail risk.
